hypotheses.T0_panels_are_balanced: Every family/split contains the same number of examples in each swap orientation.
hypotheses.T1_tensor_quotient_predicts_finite_head_: The analytic Layer-17 tensor score has Pearson correlation at least 0.8 with finite rank-1 effects across heads, and at least 0.7 after removing the strongest finite head, in every cell.
hypotheses.T2_context_only_selection_transfers_with: For each family, the head selected by routed rank-1 write RMS on split 0 ranks in the top three positive finite heads on split 1.
hypotheses.T3_output_conditioned_selection_transfer: For each family, the head selected by the output-conditioned tensor score on split 0 is the top positive finite rank-1 head on split 1.
hypotheses.T4_H2_is_a_universal_terminal_edit_compr: H2 is selected by routed rank-1 write RMS for both spelling and unrelated swaps and ranks in the top three finite heads on both held-out splits.
hypotheses.T5_H2_weight_mode_beats_random_rank1_con: On both held-out families, the signed finite H2 weight-mode effect exceeds every one of eight frozen random rank-1 directions.
hypotheses.T6_H2_postboundary_relation_is_privilege: On both held-out families, H2's complete post-boundary effect is positive and at least twice its complete at-or-before-boundary effect.
